research_result.description: Reducto is an agentic document platform that parses, extracts, classifies, splits, and edits documents across 30+ file formats using AI models via REST APIs, SDKs, and an official MCP server.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can create a free account at studio.reducto.ai and generate an API key from the API Keys section in the Studio sidebar.

evidence.claim: Reducto offers a REST API for document parsing, extraction, classification, splitting, and editing.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Reducto is the agentic document platform. It provides a complete toolkit for classification, parsing, extraction, splitting, editing, and workflow orchestration across documents (PDFs, images, spreadsheets, DOCX, and 30+ other formats) via a REST API.

evidence.claim: API calls use API keys authenticated via Bearer tokens in HTTP headers.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: For direct REST calls, pass it as a Bearer token:

evidence.claim: Developers can self-serve and sign up for a free account to get an API key.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Go to studio.reducto.ai and sign up for a free account.

evidence.claim: Reducto provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Reducto MCP server connects AI agents directly to Reducto.
